授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:
開発経済学を学ぶ上で，地域への視座あるいは地域の視座は大切です．本授業では，対象地域をロシアに設定し，経済学（開発経済学）と地域研究の観点から，ロシアの過去と現在の政治経済システムや社会について掘り下げます．
本授業では，ソ連の社会経済システム，ソ連崩壊後のロシアの経済政策，ウクライナ戦争前のロシアの経済・社会に関する書籍を輪読することを通して，現代ロシアの社会・経済への理解を深めるだけでなく，地域研究を深めるための視点の獲得を目指します．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
<Course description/ objective>
A regional perspective is essential to the study of development economics. This course focuses on Russia, exploring the country's past and present political-economic systems and society through the lenses of economics (development economics) and regional studies.
Throughout this course, we will read selected chapters from several texts and engage in discussion of topics such as the socio-economic system of the Soviet Union, economic policies in post-Soviet Russia after the collapse of the USSR, and the economic and social dimensions of Russia prior to the conflict between Ukraine and Russia.
The course aims to foster an understanding of contemporary Russian society and economy and to provide insights that deepen regional perspectives in development economics.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード:
ロシア経済，移行経済，開発経済学，地域研究，政治経済学，経済政策
Russian economy, transitional economies, development economics, regional studies, political economy, economic policy
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
＜履修要件＞
ソ連・ロシアや旧社会主義国に関する知識は必要としません．経済学，政治学，社会学分野で地域研究に関心があること（ロシア以外の地域も歓迎），その他，毎回，指定の章を読んだ上で演習に参加するなど，基本的かつ真摯な姿勢が望まれます．
<Course Expectations>:
No prior knowledge of the Soviet Union, Russia, or former socialist countries is required. However, students should have an interest in regional studies within economics, political science, or sociology (regions other than Russia are also welcome). Students are expected to take responsibility for the class by completing the assigned readings before each session and actively participate in class discussions.
